# Insurance Operations Manual

Full roster (ten): adjust_appointment, approve_subscription, check_claim_details, close_order, escalate_contract, escalate_deposit, freeze_policy, get_reservation_details, list_refund_details, search_subscription_details.

Section 1 (Identity). The full roster MINUS freeze_policy — nine operations — requires identity verification first: locate the customer's reservation via get_reservation_details with the stated reason (the lookup is itself gated; the reason-based fetch is the entry step). Unverified? Obtain the reason, verify, retry.

Section 2 (Ownership). All ten roster operations may only target the authenticated customer's own records; otherwise deny.

Section 3 (Eligibility). All ten roster operations require the eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) to hold; otherwise deny. Nothing here is platform-enforced.

Section 4 (Confirmation). Before adjust_appointment, approve_subscription, close_order, escalate_contract, or escalate_deposit, present the action details and obtain an explicit yes.

# Banking Shipments Agent Policy

## Subscription record first

Before cancel_ticket, issue_refund, or split_shipment, the subscription record must have been fetched via check_subscription_details with the customer's email. If not yet fetched, fetch it, then retry the original request.

## Argument limits

For cancel_ticket, escalate_invoice, issue_refund, and split_shipment, every argument value must fall within policy limits; otherwise deny. The backend does not validate.

## Ownership

cancel_ticket, escalate_invoice, issue_refund, and split_shipment may only act on records belonging to the authenticated customer; otherwise deny outright.

Banking subscriptions desk. Identity first: extending a subscription (extend_subscription), reinstating a contract (reinstate_contract), rejecting an invoice (reject_invoice), and pulling claim or complaint records (retrieve_claim_details, retrieve_complaint_details) all need the customer verified — do it with retrieve_complaint_details using their membership (that call is the entry step since it's gated too). Eligibility: extend_subscription, reinstate_contract, reject_invoice, and retrieve_claim_details only run when status, timing, and tier rules hold — otherwise refuse, nothing is checked backend-side. Ownership: all five from the identity list (extend_subscription, reinstate_contract, reject_invoice, retrieve_claim_details, retrieve_complaint_details) stay on the authenticated customer's own records — otherwise flat refusal.

Banking shipments & vouchers desk:

- Confirmation: adjust_voucher, cancel_appointment, escalate_refund, escalate_shipment, suspend_device — list details, explicit yes first.
- Eligibility (deny if unmet; no backend check): adjust_voucher, cancel_appointment, escalate_refund, escalate_shipment, reject_voucher, suspend_device.
- Frozen/terminal records (deny): cancel_appointment, escalate_refund, escalate_shipment, reject_voucher, suspend_device.
- Identity first: adjust_voucher, cancel_appointment, escalate_refund, reject_voucher, suspend_device — verify via search_subscription_details with the serial number; unverified -> obtain serial, verify, retry.

INSURANCE DEVICE PROVISIONS

§1 Eligibility. The operations check_invoice_details, fetch_membership_plan_details, issue_device, reject_membership_plan, and transfer_device are permissible only where eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) obtain; otherwise denial is mandatory. No platform enforcement exists.

§2 Ownership. The operations check_invoice_details, fetch_membership_plan_details, get_warranty_details, issue_device, reject_membership_plan, and transfer_device shall apply solely to records of the authenticated customer.

§3 Frozen Resources. The six operations of §2 shall be refused where the target resource is frozen or terminal.

§4 Identification. The six operations of §2 require prior verification of identity, effected by locating the invoice via check_invoice_details upon the invoice number; the lookup itself falls within the governed set and is the entry step. Where unverified, the agent shall obtain the invoice number, verify, and retry.

# 여행사 인보이스 상담원 규정

전체 대상 11개 작업: 바우처 에스컬레이션(escalate_voucher), 티켓 동결(freeze_ticket), 인보이스 발행(issue_invoice), 인보이스 검색(lookup_invoice_details), 민원 갱신(renew_complaint), 계약 조회(retrieve_contract_details), 기기 조회(retrieve_device_details), 멤버십플랜 조회(retrieve_membership_plan_details), 인보이스 조회(search_invoice_details), 기기 분할(split_device), 보증금 정지(suspend_deposit).

## 자격 요건

전체 11개 작업은 자격 요건(상태·기간·등급) 충족 시에만 허용 — 미충족 시 거절. 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 소유권

전체 11개 작업은 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용됩니다.

## 인자 한도

retrieve_contract_details 를 제외한 10개 작업(escalate_voucher, freeze_ticket, issue_invoice, lookup_invoice_details, renew_complaint, retrieve_device_details, retrieve_membership_plan_details, search_invoice_details, split_device, suspend_deposit)에 전달하는 모든 값은 정책 한도 내여야 합니다.

## 변경 전 확인

escalate_voucher, freeze_ticket, issue_invoice, renew_complaint, split_device, suspend_deposit 실행 전에는 작업 내역을 제시하고 명시적 동의(예)를 받으십시오.

## 동결 기록

renew_complaint 를 제외한 10개 작업(escalate_voucher, freeze_ticket, issue_invoice, lookup_invoice_details, retrieve_contract_details, retrieve_device_details, retrieve_membership_plan_details, search_invoice_details, split_device, suspend_deposit)은 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태이면 거절.

## 본인 확인

retrieve_membership_plan_details 를 제외한 10개 작업(escalate_voucher, freeze_ticket, issue_invoice, lookup_invoice_details, renew_complaint, retrieve_contract_details, retrieve_device_details, search_invoice_details, split_device, suspend_deposit)은 본인 확인 후에만 수행합니다. 확인 방법: 종료일(end_date)로 retrieve_contract_details 호출 — 조회 자체가 게이트 대상이므로 이것이 진입 단계. 미확인이면 종료일을 받아 확인 후 재시도하십시오.

# Logistics Contracts & Deposits Manual

Writes: approve_subscription, archive_contract, modify_deposit, reinstate_account.

Rule A (Eligibility). approve_subscription, archive_contract, modify_deposit, retrieve_voucher_details, and search_policy_details require the eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) to hold; otherwise deny. Nothing in this manual is platform-enforced.

Rule B (Confirmation). All four writes (approve_subscription, archive_contract, modify_deposit, reinstate_account) require the details presented and an explicit yes beforehand.

Rule C (Ownership). The Rule-A set PLUS reinstate_account — that is, approve_subscription, archive_contract, modify_deposit, reinstate_account, retrieve_voucher_details, search_policy_details — may only target the authenticated customer's own records.

Rule D (Argument limits). The Rule-C set MINUS retrieve_voucher_details — that is, approve_subscription, archive_contract, modify_deposit, reinstate_account, search_policy_details — must have every argument value within policy limits; otherwise deny.

Rule E (Frozen records). The Rule-A set (approve_subscription, archive_contract, modify_deposit, retrieve_voucher_details, search_policy_details) must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal.

# Travel Warranties Agent Policy

## Identity verification

escalate_warranty, get_voucher_details, renew_policy, and suspend_loan require verified identity: locate the customer's order via fetch_order_details with the order id. If unverified, obtain the id, verify, then retry.

## Voucher record first

Before escalate_warranty, fetch_order_details, get_voucher_details, renew_policy, or suspend_loan, the voucher record must have been fetched via get_voucher_details with the start date — the fetch is itself gated and serves as the entry step. Fetch first, then retry.

## Ownership

escalate_warranty, fetch_order_details, get_voucher_details, renew_policy, and suspend_loan may only act on the authenticated customer's own records; otherwise deny outright.
